identity.statusNote: The seed-provided websiteUrl (lightroommobile.com) is not Adobe's domain and appears incorrect; the mobile Lightroom app is distributed and priced via adobe.com.

freePlan.limits: Lightroom for mobile is a free iOS/Android app for capturing, editing and sharing photos, with in-app upgrade to premium features.

keyLimits.en: Free iOS/Android app with core capture, editing and sharing tools; no cloud storage plan included.
Full Lightroom on mobile, desktop and web plus Lightroom Classic; 1TB cloud storage; annual plan billed monthly.
Adds Photoshop on desktop and mobile to the Lightroom plan; 1TB cloud storage; annual plan billed monthly.

cautions.en: Prices shown are the promotional annual-billed-monthly rate; Creative Cloud Pro (20+ apps including Lightroom) is offered at an introductory $34.99/mo for 3 months before reverting to $69.99/mo.

capabilities.en: Non-destructive photo editing with presets, on mobile, desktop and web, synced via the cloud.
Free mobile app for capture, editing and sharing without requiring a paid subscription.
Cloud storage and sync across devices included with paid plans (1TB on Lightroom and Photography plans).

limitations.en: Full desktop-grade editing and cloud storage require a paid Lightroom or Photography subscription; the free mobile app alone is limited.
Part of the Adobe Creative Cloud ecosystem, meaning cancellation and pricing changes follow Adobe's broader subscription terms.

reason.en: One-time-purchase photo editing alternative to Adobe's subscription model.
Free mobile photo editing app, direct alternative to Lightroom mobile for casual editing.
Broader creative tool sometimes used as a lighter-weight alternative for photo editing and sharing.

unknowns: Seed's websiteUrl (lightroommobile.com) does not resolve to an Adobe-owned page; treated as an error and replaced with the official Adobe Lightroom URL in this dossier.
Exact feature gating between the free mobile app and paid plans (e.g. which edits require a subscription) not fully detailed on the plans page.
conflicts: Seed websiteUrl (https://lightroommobile.com) conflicts with the official Adobe product domain; flagged in identity.statusNote.
